title: Are towels and linen provided?

post.title: Are towels and linen provided?
post.html: Yes, All bed linen and one bath sheet and hand towel per guest is provided, EXCEPT where cots are requested, please bring all cot bedding and baby towels you require

description: All bed linen, plus one bath sheet and hand towel per guest, is provided. Please bring your own cot bedding and baby towels.
